data.description: In a recent development, Identiv, Inc. has rebranded itself as INVE Technologies, Inc. data.title: Attalon and AeroVironment Execute Long-Term Agreement Supporting Production of Mission-Ready High-Energy Laser Systems
data.description: Philadelphia-based AeroVironment has signed a long-term agreement (LTA) with Attalon for the delivery of Attalon's Valaris high-energy laser platform. The agreement aims to support AeroVironment's LOCUST® and other high-energy laser programs as interest in mission-ready directed energy capabilities increases. The partnership comes in response to the growing demand for deployable directed energy solutions. This collaboration will see the integration of Attalon's advanced laser technology into AeroVironment's product line, enhancing its portfolio of high-energy laser offerings.

data.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS) based in DUBUQUE, Iowa, has reported that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share. The dividend will be payable on October 12, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. Notably, Flexsteel has continuously paid out cash dividends on its common stock every year since 1938, marking this upcoming dividend as the 339th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. The company, commonly referred to as Flexsteel, is recognized as one of the largest residential furniture manufacturers.

data.title: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Limited Receives Nasdaq Notice Regarding Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description: Baosheng has been notified by Nasdaq regarding their stock's failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1 per share. They now have until March 9, 2027, to increase the stock price and regain compliance with Nasdaq regulations. Despite this notification, Baosheng's listing on the exchange will remain active during this period.

data.title: BKV Completes Acquisition of Barnett Shale Upstream, Midstream, and Carbon Capture Assets
data.description: In Denver, BKV Corporation (NYSE: BKV) has successfully finalized the purchase of specific Barnett Shale upstream, midstream, and CCS assets. The exact details of the deal remain undisclosed. This acquisition signifies a significant step forward for BKV as it enhances their closed-loop energy approach. By incorporating additional top-notch, low-decline Barnett Shale assets into their portfolio, BKV is intensifying its operational reach and boosting production capacity. These assets align well with the Company’s current operations and infrastructure, paving the way for further growth.

data.title: TechnipFMC Awarded iEPCI® Contract for PETRONAS’ Limbayong Project Offshore Malaysia
data.description: TechnipFMC has shared that its subsidiary, FMC Wellhead Equipment Sdn. Bhd., received a noteworthy(1) integrated Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (iEPCI®) contract from PETRONAS Carigali Sdn. Bhd. for the Limbayong deepwater project in Malaysia. This deal involves utilizing the Subsea 2.0® configure-to-order (CTO) platform and iEPCI® techniques for the subsea scope, aiming to minimize costs and enhance efficiency. The project is set to bring substantial benefits to both companies and the region.
